blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved. Current state-of-the-art methods reconstruct the scene explicitly by estimating depth, lifting the video into a point cloud, and re-rendering it from the egocentric camera to condition a video diffusion model. This deterministic mapping assigns each pixel to a single reprojected location, which preserves texture but translates depth errors into misplaced content. We ask what a video diffusion model should receive as its condition and propose a lifting-free answer: a learned view synthesizer, an LVSM-style transformer fine-tuned to render the egocentric view directly without depth, point clouds, or reprojection, resolving cross-view correspondence internally. In contrast, its probabilistic mapping averages each region over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, preserving structure while fine texture is averaged away. We argue that this trade-off suits a diffusion generator, whose denoising training excels at restoring detail, so an effective condition should prioritize structural alignment over sharpness. This distribution's concentration also yields a per-region confidence, used both to mask low-confidence regions and to guide the generator toward high-confidence areas during early layout-forming denoising steps. Our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline and generalizes to other datasets without retraining. The synthesizer thus supplies view structure, and the diffusion model its detail.
blocks.zh: 从一个单一的异心录制中生成一个自我中心视频,是新视觉合成的一个挑战性案例,因为两台相机几乎没有重叠之处,而且许多目标视图都无人观察. 目前最先进的方法通过估计深度,将视频提升到点云中,再从以自我为中心的相机中重新赋予它来对视频传播模型进行条件化,来明确重建场景. 这种确定性映射将每个像素分配到一个单一的重投影位置,这保存了纹理,但将深度错误转换成错误的内容. 我们问视频传播模型应该收到什么作为条件,并提出一个免升空的答案:一个有学识的视图合成器,一个LVSM风格的变压器经过微调,可以直接使以自我为中心的视图没有深度,点云,或者重新投射,解决内部的交叉视图对应. 与此相反,其概率制图根据所学的函授分布,平均衡量每个区域候选来源地点,保持结构,而精细的纹理平均消失。 我们主张,这种权衡应适合传播发电机,这种发电机的授意训练在恢复细节方面非常出色,因此,一个有效的条件应该优先考虑结构调整而不是锐度。 这种分布的集中还产生每个地区的信心,既用来掩盖低信心地区,又用来引导生成者在早期布局化的去诺化步骤中向高自信地区发展. 我们的做法一贯优于最先进的明确管道,并在不进行再培训的情况下向其他数据集概括。 合成器因此供给了视图结构,以及其细节的传播模型.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: We study exocentric-to-egocentric video generation: given a single third-person recording of a scene and a target egocentric camera trajectory, the goal is to synthesize the video a camera following this trajectory would capture. The task matters wherever first-person data is scarce and third-person footage abundant ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , and it is demanding: the two views share little content, so much of the target must be synthesized rather than copied. Existing methods condition implicitly on exocentric features ( Luo et al., 2024b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) ; assume privileged inputs such as surrounding cameras ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , rich multimodal observations ( Park et al., 2026 ) , or a ground-truth egocentric first frame ( Xu et al., 2025 ) ; or reconstruct the scene explicitly. The current state of the art ( Kang et al., 2026 ) takes the explicit route, conditioning a video diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) on a point-cloud render obtained by lifting the exocentric video with monocular depth and replaying it from the egocentric trajectory. This route inherits the errors of the estimated depth: depth errors misplace the content of the point-cloud render, sharply and without any signal of where it is wrong.
blocks.zh: 我们研究异心对异心的视频生成:鉴于一个场景的单个第三人称录制以及目标自负相机的轨迹,目标是按照这个轨迹将相机合成相机。 只要第一人称数据稀缺,第三人称镜头丰富(Grauman等,2024年),任务就事关重大,要求是:两种观点的内容都很少,因此许多目标必须被合成而不是复制. 现有方法隐含地以外心特征为条件(Luo等,2024b;Cheng等,2024;承担周边相机等特权投入(Liu等,2024a),丰富的多模式观测). (Park et al., 2026),或以地真相为中心自负为第一帧(徐等, 2025;或明确重建场景. 目前艺术的状态(Kang等,2026年)采取明确的路线,在以单向深度取出外向视频并取自自自心轨迹回放而获得的点云渲染上搭建了视频传播模型(Wan等,2025年). 此路由继承了估计深度的错误: 深度错误将点- 云渲染的内容错位, 尖锐并没有任何错误位置的信号 。

blocks.en: We present LEGO ( L ifting-free exocentric-to- EGO centric video generation; Fig. 2 ), a lifting-free alternative that replaces the reconstruction pipeline with a learned view synthesizer that renders the egocentric view directly. An LVSM-style transformer ( Jin et al., 2025 ) is fine-tuned to map the exocentric frame and the target camera rays to the egocentric image, so cross-view correspondence is learned from the rendering objective alone. The frozen synthesizer’s render replaces the point-cloud render in the generator’s conditioning input; no depth estimation, point cloud, or reprojection is involved.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LEGO(Lifting-free exocent-to-EGO central video generation;图2),这是一个无起起伏的替代品,它用一个有学识的视野合成器来取代重建管道,使自负心的视角直接被取而代之. LVSM风格的变压器(Jin等,2025年)被微调以将外向相框和目标相机射线映射到自负相中,因此交叉相机单从渲染目标中学习. 冷冻合成器的渲染取代了发电机调制输入中的点-云;没有涉及深度估计、点云或再预测。

blocks.en: The design follows from the paper’s central question: what should a video diffusion model be given as its condition? The two renders fail in opposite ways. The point-cloud render is deterministic: each pixel is assigned a single reprojected location, so its errors are misplaced content. The synthesizer’s render is probabilistic: each region averages over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, so its errors are blur. These failures are not equally costly: blur is the corruption that denoising training teaches the generator to undo, and diffusion models routinely recover sharp detail from blurred inputs ( Saharia et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) , whereas rough or misplaced conditions have needed dedicated mechanisms to relax them ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Seo et al., 2024 ) . We therefore argue that a condition should be judged by alignment first and sharpness second, since the generator supplies the second far more readily than the first: the condition should say where things are, and the generator will decide how they look. The correspondence distribution supplies a further signal for this: its concentration at each region is a confidence, and we mask from the conditioning those regions where it is low.
blocks.zh: 设计源自论文的核心问题:视频传播模型应该提供什么条件? 两者使失败的方式相反。 点-云渲染是决定性的:每个像素被分配到一个单一的再投影位置,所以其错误是错误的内容. 合成器的渲染是概率性的:每个区域根据所学到的函授分布,平均超过候选源位置,因此其出错模糊. 这些失败并不是同样昂贵的:模糊不清的腐败,这种腐败使培训教导生成者去除,传播模式经常从模糊的投入中恢复出尖锐的细节(Saharia等人,2023年;Ho等人,2022年;Meng等人,2022年),而粗糙或错误的条件需要专门的机制来放松(Liu等人,2024年b;Seo等人,2024年)。 因此,我们主张,一个条件应该首先通过调整来判断,其次是尖锐性,因为发电机供应第二个条件比第一个条件要容易得多:条件应该说明情况所在,发电机将决定它们的样子。 通信分发为此提供了又一信号:它集中在每个地区是一种信心,我们掩盖了那些低水平的地区。

blocks.en: Alignment first, detail second also describes the sampling trajectory itself: layout is decided in the early, high-noise steps and detail emerges later, so structural guidance is most useful early. We therefore reuse the same confidence at inference, guiding the early denoising steps toward the render where it is high and leaving the rest unconstrained. This requires no additional training; we call it Adaptive Rendering Consistency (ARC, Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 第一,细节第二也描述了采样轨迹本身:布局在早期,高噪步骤中决定,而后出现细节,因此结构取向在早期最为有用. 因此,我们在推论中重新利用同样的信心,指导早期向高处倾斜的步骤,使其余部分不受限制。 这不需要额外的培训;我们称之为适应性渲染一致性(ARC, 第3.3节)。

blocks.en: On Ego-Exo4D, the synthesizer’s render outperforms the point-cloud render as a condition, ARC at inference alone outperforms the depth-derived attention bias with which prior work trains the generator, and the full system outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline on seen and unseen scenes; the same weights also generalize to EgoHumans and Nymeria without retraining.
blocks.zh: 在Ego-Exo4D上,合成器的渲染性能超过了点-云的渲染性,作为条件,ARC在推论中单是超越了先前工作训练发电机时的深源注意力偏差,整个系统在所见和所不见的场景上也超越了最先进的明确管道;同样的分量也在Ego Humans和Nymeria身上被概括而无需再培训.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) LEGO , a lifting-free exocentric-to-egocentric video generation framework that conditions a video diffusion model on the confidence-gated render of a learned view synthesizer instead of a point-cloud reconstruction; (2) evidence that a structurally aligned but soft condition serves the generator better than a sharp but misplaced one; (3) ARC, training-free guidance that reuses the synthesizer’s confidence to steer the early denoising steps toward its render; and (4) state-of-the-art results on Ego-Exo4D and generalization to EgoHumans and Nymeria without retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) LEGO, 一个无起伏外向外向心的视频生成框架, 将视频传播模型作为条件, 由有学识的视图合成器进行自信渲染, 而不是点-云重建; (2) 有证据表明结构一致但柔软的条件比尖锐但错位的条件更有利于生成者; (3) ARC, 无培训指导, 重新利用合成者的信心, 引导早期的去诺步骤向渲染; (4) Ego-Exo4D 的先进成果, 并在不进行再培训的情况下向Ego Humans和Nymeria通俗化。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early systems relied on privileged inputs: surrounding cameras ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , rich multimodal exocentric observations ( Park et al., 2026 ) , or the ground-truth egocentric first frame ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Others condition implicitly on exocentric features ( Luo et al., 2024b ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . The state of the art, EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , takes a single exocentric video and reconstructs the scene explicitly: depth from a video pose engine ( Huang et al., 2025a ) lifts the frames into a point cloud, which is re-rendered along the egocentric trajectory to condition a video diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and the generator is trained with a depth-derived attention bias. Concurrent and adjacent work extends this explicit line ( Gu et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2026 ) , reverses the direction or transfers exocentric knowledge ( Luo et al., 2024a ; Xiu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , or pairs the two views for recognition ( Sigurdsson et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2021 ) . LEGO keeps the single-video setting and diffusion backbone of EgoX, but replaces the reconstruction with a learned view synthesizer and the training-time attention bias with training-free guidance.
blocks.zh: 早期系统依赖于特权输入:周边相机(Liu等,2024a),丰富的多模式异心观测(Park等,2026),或地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地- 另一些则隐含地以外向特征为条件(Luo等,2024b;Cheng等,2024.). 最新艺术 EgoX (Kang等,2026年)取出单一外向视频并明确重建场景:从视频姿势引擎取来深度(Huang等,2025a)将相框抬入点云,沿自心轨迹再取回以条件视频传播模型(Wan等,2025年)为条件的相框,并用深度衍生的注意力偏差来训练出相机. 同时进行的工作和相邻的工作延长了这一明确界线(Gu等,2026;Song等,2026;Mahdi等,2026;),扭转方向或转移外心知识(Luo等,2024a; Xiu等, 2026; Zhang等, 2026),或将两种观点相配以获得认可(Sigurdsson等, 2018;Li等, 2021). LEGO保留了EgoX的单视频设置与传播主干,但以学习的视野合成器来取而代之的是重建,以无培训指导来取而代之的是培训时间的注意力偏向.

blocks.en: Camera poses can steer video diffusion directly, through extrinsics or Plücker embeddings injected into the backbone ( He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Bahmani et al., 2025 ) or by re-rendering a video along a new trajectory ( Bai et al., 2025a ) . For larger viewpoint changes, systems lift the video into explicit 3D and condition generation on a render of the target trajectory ( Yu et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2025a ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ) . EgoX follows this recipe in a setting where the view change is extreme and estimated depth is least reliable; LEGO takes the same pose inputs but is lifting-free.
blocks.zh: 相机姿势可以直接引导视频传播,通过外向或Plücker嵌入注入骨干(He等人,2025年;Wang等人,2024年;Bahmani等人,2025年),或沿着新轨迹重新发送视频(Bai等人,2025a年)。 对于较大的视角变化,系统在目标轨迹的渲染上将视频提升为明确的立体和条件生成(Yu等人,2025b;Yu等人,2025a; Ren等,2025;Huang等,2025b.). EgoX在视图变化极端而估计深度最不可靠的情况下遵循这一配方;LEGO采取相同的姿势输入,但无起起落.

blocks.en: Novel view synthesis has moved from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models that predict radiance fields, 3D Gaussians, or triplanes in a single pass ( Yu et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Charatan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) ; LVSM ( Jin et al., 2025 ) maps posed input tokens to target-ray tokens with a plain transformer. Rendering supervision is known to teach geometry: photometric view synthesis losses made monocular depth learnable without ground truth ( Garg et al., 2016 ; Zhou et al., 2017 ) . Self-supervised and diffusion features likewise acquire correspondence they were never supervised for ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Amir et al., 2022 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) . We rely on the same effect in a synthesizer fine-tuned for the exocentric-to-egocentric view change: its render serves as the generator’s condition, and the concentration of its correspondence distribution as a per-region confidence (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 小说取景合成已经从人均景区优化转向了预测光场,3D高斯人,或单行道的向导模型(Yu等,2021;Liu等,2023;Hong等,2024;Charatan等,2024;Chen等,2024;LVSM等,2025)地图对有平面变压器的目标射线符号提出了输入符. 渲染监督已知为教几何:光度透视合成损耗使单相光深度无地真能学习(Garg等,2016;周等,2017. 自我监督和传播特征同样获得从未被监督的通信(Caron等,2021;Amir等,2022;Tang等,2023;Zhang等,2023;Luo等,2023)。 我们所依赖的是一个合成器中的相同效果,该合成器对异心-异心-观点的变化进行了微调:它的渲染是产生器的状态,其通信分布集中成为每个区域的信心(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Conditional diffusion models recover fine detail from coarse inputs: super-resolution and cascaded generation upsample low-resolution images, and blurring the condition during training helps rather than hurts ( Saharia et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022 ) ; SDEdit synthesizes realistic images from stroke layouts ( Meng et al., 2022 ) ; GeNVS produces sharp novel views from a volume-rendered feature image ( Chan et al., 2023 ) ; and blur can serve as the forward corruption a diffusion model learns to invert ( Rissanen et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom and Salimans, 2023 ) , with coarse structure decided at high noise and detail at low noise ( Choi et al., 2022 ; Rissanen et al., 2023 ) . Conversely, precise conditions are neither required nor always safe: layout-level depth suffices for depth-conditioned control ( Bhat et al., 2024 ) , control must be relaxed where a rough condition is wrong ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and generation from a depth-based reprojection must learn where to trust it ( Seo et al., 2024 ) . We read these results as favoring a condition that is aligned before it is sharp.
blocks.zh: 有条件的传播模型从粗糙的投入中恢复出精细的细节:超分辨率和级联生成的低分辨率图像,并模糊了训练期间的状况有助于而不是伤害(Saharia等,2023;Ho等,2022;SDedit从中风布局中合成出现实的图像(Meng等,2022;GENVS从量产特征图像中产生尖锐的新观点(Chan等,2023;和模糊可成为传播模型中学会的先行腐败(Rissanen等,2023;Hoogeboom和Salimans,2023)),低噪音中以高噪音和细节决定的粗结构(Choi等,2022;Rissanen等,2023)。 反之,精确的条件既不需要也不总是安全的:布局-平面深度足以进行有深度条件的控制(Bhat等,2024年),在粗糙的条件错误时必须放松控制(Liu等,2024年b),从深层再投射的一代必须学会相信它的位置(Seo等,2024年). 我们把这些结果看成是赞成一个在尖锐化之前一致的条件。

blocks.en: Pretrained diffusion models can be steered at sampling time: ILVR ( Choi et al., 2021 ) , RePaint ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ) , and Blended Diffusion ( Avrahami et al., 2022 ) blend a reference into the intermediate sample; DDRM ( Kawar et al., 2022 ) and DDNM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) project each step onto measurement-consistent solutions; DPS ( Chung et al., 2023 ) , MCG ( Chung et al., 2022 ) , and FreeDoM ( Yu et al., 2023 ) apply guidance gradients. All assume the reliable content and its mask are given; ARC obtains both from the synthesizer and acts only in the early steps.
blocks.zh: 在取样时,可引导经过预先训练的传播模型:ILVR(Choi等,2021年),RePaint(Lugmayr等,2022年),和Blended Divusion(Avrahami等,2022年)将一个参考物混入中间样本;DDRM(Kawar等,2022年)和DDNM(Wang等,2023年),每个步骤都进入符合测量要求的解决方案;DPS(Chung等,2023年),MCG。 (Chung等人,2022年),和FreeDoM. (Yu等人,2023年)应用了指导梯度. 所有假设都给出了可靠的内容及其口罩;ARC既从合成器获得,也只在早期步骤中行动.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We follow the input setting of EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) : a single exocentric video with its camera calibration, and a target egocentric camera trajectory along which the video is to be generated. All experiments use the same image-to-video diffusion backbone and canvas formulation as EgoX, in which the exocentric and egocentric views are concatenated along the width and the egocentric half of the conditioning latent carries the condition for the target view. Prior work fills this conditioning input with a point-cloud render and, in addition, trains the generator with a depth-derived bias on the cross-view attention. LEGO fills it with the render of a frozen view synthesizer (Section 3.1 ), gates the render by the confidence of the synthesizer’s correspondence distribution (Section 3.2 ), and uses the same confidence to guide the early denoising steps toward the render (Section 3.3 ). The pipeline is lifting-free: no depth is estimated and no point cloud is built at any stage. We do not modify the generator. We change the condition it receives and how it is sampled (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们遵循EgoX(Kang等,2026年)的输入设置: 一个单一的离心相机 和它的相机校正, 以及一个目标自我中心相机轨迹 所有实验都使用和"EgoX"一样的图像到视频传播主干和画布配制,其中外向和自负中心的观点会沿着宽度被调和而自负中心半个条件潜入带入目标视图的条件. 先前的工作用点-云渲染来填充这个条件输入,此外,还训练发电机在交叉视图注意上有深度偏差. LEGO用冷冻的视图合成器的成像(第3.1节),通过合成器的通信分配的置信度(第3.2节),打开成像口(第3.3节),并使用同样的置信度来指导早日向成像口点名的步骤(第3.3节)。 管道为无起起伏道:无深度估计,任何阶段都不建点云. 我们不修改生成器。 我们改变它得到的条件和如何取样(图2)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Learned View Synthesizer
blocks.zh: 3.1 学习视图合成器

blocks.en: The two mappings fail differently. The explicit mapping assigns each target pixel a single source pixel, which keeps texture sharp but translates a depth error directly into misplaced content; in statistical terms, its error is a bias. The learned mapping averages over the candidate sources in p 𝐮 p_{\mathbf{u}} , which blurs texture wherever the distribution is spread out but keeps content close to its correct place; its error is a variance. Denoising training makes the generator well suited to restoring detail ( Saharia et al., 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022 ; Chan et al., 2023 ) , so blur is the failure it is best equipped to correct, whereas conditions that are sharp but misplaced have required dedicated mechanisms to relax or override them ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Seo et al., 2024 ) . This is why we condition on F F ’s render rather than on the point-cloud render; Section 4 tests the choice, and Fig. 3 contrasts the two pipelines.

blocks.en: The published LVSM checkpoint, which we call the untuned synthesizer, is trained to interpolate between nearby pinhole views, whereas our target is an extrapolation to a fisheye headset camera that shares little overlap with the source. Because every camera-specific quantity enters F F through the ray map, no architectural change is needed: we invert the calibrated fisheye projection per pixel to obtain the target rays, and fine-tune all of its weights on exocentric-egocentric pairs, supervised by the raw fisheye recordings. Supervising on real recordings also teaches F F where the lens does not see, which the ray map alone cannot express (Appendix C.3 ). The fine-tuning is cheap, 10,000 steps or about 3.5 hours on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs, and F F is frozen afterwards.

blocks.en: The gated render enters the generator as its conditioning input. Prior work additionally steers the generator with a depth-derived bias on cross-view attention, applied throughout training. We instead act on the denoising trajectory at inference time: during the early steps, in which the layout of the sample is determined ( Choi et al., 2022 ; Rissanen et al., 2023 ) , the generator’s current estimate of the clean video is moved toward the render in proportion to the confidence, and the remaining steps are left unconstrained. blocks.en:
We train and evaluate on Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) following the protocol of EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) . The benchmark has two test splits: seen , whose scenes appear in the training set, and unseen , whose scenes do not. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, CLIP-I, and FVD are computed on the generated egocentric frames, and the VBench scores for temporal flickering (TF), motion smoothness (MS), and dynamic degree (DD) on the full exocentric–egocentric canvas. We compare with the numbers reported in Kang et al. (2026) and with the released EgoX checkpoint rerun under our evaluation code, denoted EgoX † .
For a fair comparison, all ablations use the same backbone, LoRA rank, training schedule, random seed, and camera trajectories. blocks.en: We claim in Section 3.1 that a blurry but geometrically aligned condition is better than a sharp but misaligned one. Table 3 tests this on the unseen split by measuring both properties of each conditioning render against the ground truth. Alignment is measured by zero-mean normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC) and the similarity of DINO features ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) at the same location. Sharpness is measured by the Laplacian variance relative to the ground truth. The two renders are opposite: the synthesizer render is the blurriest but the best aligned, while the point-cloud render is sharp but poorly aligned. Despite its blur, the synthesizer render conditions the diffusion model better (Table 2 ). The blur of the condition does not remain in the output: generations from the two renders reach the same sharpness (Appendix C.2 ), which indicates that the diffusion model restores the details missing from the condition. The synthesizer render is also much cheaper to compute than depth estimation and point-cloud rendering (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: Fig. 6 compares EgoX and LEGO on the benchmark datasets and on in-the-wild videos. On in-the-wild videos, for which no ground truth exists, the gap widens: the point-cloud render of EgoX becomes unreliable and its generated views break away from the exocentric video, whereas LEGO keeps them consistent. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: LEGO conditions a video diffusion model on the render of a learned view synthesizer, not a point-cloud reconstruction, on one criterion: a condition should be aligned before it is sharp, because the generator restores detail far more readily than it corrects misplaced content. The design has three practical advantages. It is lifting-free, with no depth estimation, point cloud, or reprojection at any stage. Its confidence comes free from the synthesizer’s correspondence distribution and drives both the gating and a training-free guidance that replaces a bias the generator must be trained with. And the frozen synthesizer enters only through its render and confidence, so the same weights carry over to new scenes and recordings without retraining, and a stronger synthesizer can be dropped in as one appears. The synthesizer supplies the structure of the view, and the diffusion model its detail.
blocks.zh: LEGO在一个标准上将视频传播模型作为条件,即一个已学习到的视图合成器的渲染,而不是一个点-云重建:一个条件在尖锐化之前应该对齐,因为生成器恢复细节比纠正错误的内容要快得多. 该设计有三个实际优势. 它没有升起,没有深度估计,没有点云,也没有在任何阶段进行再预测。 它的信心来自合成器的函文分发,并驱动了取景和无训练指导,以取代发电机必须训练的偏差。 而被冷冻的合成器只能通过它的渲染和信心进入,因此同样的重量会结转到新的场景和录音中而无需再培训,一个更强大的合成器可以像一个看起来那样投放. 合成器供给了视图的结构,以及其细节的传播模型.

blocks.en: F F has the architecture of the released scene-level LVSM decoder ( Jin et al., 2025 ) : 24 transformer blocks of width 768 with 12 heads and patch size 8. Source tokens carry RGB and the six Plücker channels; target tokens carry the six ray channels only. We initialize from the published checkpoint and fine-tune all weights on Ego-Exo4D at 448 × 448 448{\times}448 egocentric and 448 × 784 448{\times}784 exocentric resolution, with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} loss and an LPIPS loss weighted by 0.5. Training uses AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , cosine decay with 500 warm-up steps, a global batch size of 16, and 10k steps, about 3.5 hours on 4 H200 GPUs. The confidence of Eq. 4 is read from the attention of the last 8 layers, averaged over heads, with the softmax restricted to exocentric keys, and average-pooled 2 × 2 2{\times}2 to the token grid of the generator ( 28 × 28 28{\times}28 egocentric queries).

blocks.en: The backbone is Wan2.1-I2V-14B at 480P ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , fine-tuned with LoRA of rank 256 and α = 256 \alpha{=}256 on a 49 × 448 × 1232 49{\times}448{\times}1232 canvas, the exocentric frame (784 wide) concatenated with the egocentric frame. Training runs for 20k steps with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , bf16, a batch size of 1 per GPU on 4 H200 GPUs, and seed 42; all ablations share this recipe. The backbone is also conditioned on a text prompt, at training and at inference alike, as in EgoX. On Ego-Exo4D we use the prompts released with the benchmark. EgoHumans and Nymeria come with none, so we generate one for every test clip from eight exocentric frames, following the system prompt of EgoX and its two-block format, an [Exo view] description of the scene followed by an [Ego view] description of the target viewpoint. We replace only the vision-language model, GPT-4o in EgoX, with the open Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , and match the prompt length to the distribution of the released Ego-Exo4D prompts. At inference both methods receive the same prompt for a given clip. Inference uses 50 denoising steps with classifier-free guidance 5.0. Confidence gating uses k = 16 k{=}16 and τ = 0.3 \tau{=}0.3 on the synthesizer’s 56 × 56 56{\times}56 query grid. ARC applies Eq. 6 after each denoising step during the first 80% of the schedule ( h = 0.8 h{=}0.8 ), with the noise level floored at 0.05. blocks.en: To compare fairly with EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , we match its training and inference configuration wherever the released code specifies it: backbone checkpoint, LoRA rank and alpha, canvas resolution, optimizer, learning rate, precision, batch size, seed, noising and loss masks, sampler, number of denoising steps, guidance scale, and frame count. blocks.en: B.3 Object-Level Metrics
blocks.zh: B.3 对象级计量

blocks.en: EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) reports three object-level metrics: LocErr , the distance between the bounding-box centers of matched objects in the generated and ground-truth frames; IoU , the overlap of their bounding boxes; and Contour , the agreement of their shapes. Computing them requires a detection and matching pipeline that is not part of the public release. We therefore fix one protocol, validate it against the published numbers, and apply it unchanged to all methods.
blocks.zh: EgoX(Kang等,2026年)报告了三个对象级的度量衡:LocErr,在生成的和地上真实的框中匹配对象的相接框中心之间的距离;IoU,其相接框的重叠;Contour,其形状的一致. 计算它们需要一个检测和匹配的管道,而该管道不是公共发布的一部分。 因此,我们确定一项协议,对照公布的数字加以验证,并对所有方法不加修改地适用。

blocks.en: Objects are segmented and tracked with SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) on the generated and the ground-truth video independently, using automatic mask generation on the first frame (32 points per side, seed boxes of at least 32 px, mask regions of at least 2000 px 2 ). Each object crop is embedded with DINOv3 ViT-L ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , and two objects in the same frame are matched when the cosine similarity of their embeddings is at least 0.9, without one-to-one assignment, as described in EgoX. LocErr and IoU are computed on the matched boxes and averaged per clip and then over clips. For Contour, the literal definition in EgoX is the mask IoU in image coordinates, but it cannot reproduce the published values, which exceed the published box IoU by a wide margin; the boundary F-score after aligning the mask centroids does reproduce them, so we adopt it.
blocks.zh: 物体在生成的SAM 2(Ravi等,2025年)和地面真实视频上进行分块并跟踪,在第一帧使用自动口罩生成(每侧32分,种子箱至少32px,口罩区至少2000px 2. 每个对象作物被嵌入到DINOv3 VIT-L (Siméoni等,2025年)中,当其嵌入物的同位素相近性至少为0.9,没有一对一的任务时,同一框架的两个对象会相配,如EgoX所描述. LocErr 和 IoU 是在相匹配的框上计算出来的,每个片段平均,然后是超片段。 对于Contour,EgoX中的字面定义是图像坐标中的口罩IoU,但它不能再复制已公布的数值,这些数值比已公布的方框IoU大相径庭;在对接口罩中间机器人后边界F-分数确实复制它们,所以我们采纳.

blocks.en: B.5 Cross-Dataset Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.5 跨数据集评价

blocks.en: This subsection describes how the test clips of EgoHumans and Nymeria are selected and how their videos are prepared for evaluation. Both datasets record the egocentric view with Project Aria glasses, so the egocentric camera is the same fisheye model as in Ego-Exo4D.
blocks.zh: 本分节描述了如何选择Ego Humans和Nymeria的测试片段,以及他们的视频如何为评价做准备. 两个数据集都用"阿里亚项目"眼镜记录了以自我为中心的观点,因此以自我为中心相机与"Ego-Exo4D"中的鱼眼模型相同.

blocks.en: This dataset ( Khirodkar et al., 2023 ) records multi-person activities with several exocentric cameras and is not used for training. We select 200 clips of 49 frames, distributed evenly over the seven activity scenarios and drawn from multiple takes per scenario. Within a take, the wearer and the starting frame are sampled at regular intervals with a fixed seed. For each clip we use a single exocentric camera, the one in which the wearer is closest to the image center. The exocentric frames are resized and center-cropped to the canvas resolution, and the egocentric frames are the raw fisheye recordings, as in Ego-Exo4D.
blocks.zh: 本数据集(Khirodkar等,2023年)记录多人活动,有多台外心相机,不用于训练. 我们从49个框架中选取200个片段,平均分布在7个活动场景中,并取自每个场景的多个片段。 在取出范围内,穿行器和起跑架会以固定种子定期取出取出样本. 对于每个片段,我们使用一个单一的外向相机,穿戴者最接近图像中心的相机. 外心相框被调整出大小并被中取回到帆布分辨率上,自负相框是生鱼眼的录音,如Ego-Exo4D.

blocks.en: This dataset ( Ma et al., 2024 ) records a participant and an observer, both wearing Aria glasses, and is not used for training. The observer takes the role of the exocentric camera. Since the observer moves, we use only 49-frame windows in which the observer camera is effectively static, with at most 4 cm of translation and 2.5 ∘ 2.5^{\circ} of rotation. We further require that the participant’s head is visible in the observer’s view throughout the window, which we check by projecting the participant’s camera center into the observer’s frame and by detecting a person at the projected location. From the resulting pool we select 200 clips over 26 sequences, balancing the number of clips per sequence. The observer’s fisheye frames are undistorted to a pinhole camera with a focal length of 260 pixels and cropped to the canvas resolution.
blocks.zh: 这个数据集(Ma等,2024年)记录一名参与者和一名观察员,两人都戴着阿里亚眼镜,不用于训练. 观察者扮演外向相机的角色. 自观察者移动起,我们只使用49个框架的窗口,其中观察相机是有效的静态的,最多有4厘米的翻译和2.5分的自转. 我们进一步要求参加者的头部在整个窗口的观察者视野中可见,我们通过将参加者的相机中心投射到观察员的相机框中,并通过在预定地点发现一个人来检查。 从产生的池中,我们从26个序列中选择了200个片段,平衡了每个序列的片段数量. 观察者的鱼眼框架被浸入了焦距为260像素的针孔相机并被收缩到帆布分辨率上。

blocks.en: Both datasets are scored with the evaluation code on the egocentric frames of the same clips. EgoX is run with the authors’ released checkpoint and pipeline, including depth estimation, point-cloud rendering, and geometry-guided attention. Both methods use the same hyperparameters as on Ego-Exo4D.
blocks.zh: 这两套数据集都以同一片段自相残杀的自相残杀帧上的评价代码来打分. EgoX与提交人释放的检查站和管道一起运行,包括深度估计、点云渲染和几何指导的注意。 这两种方法都使用与"Ego-Exo4D"上相同的超参数.

blocks.en: C.1 Alignment, Sharpness, and Coverage
blocks.zh: C.1 调整、精简和覆盖

blocks.en: The synthesizer render is better aligned than the point-cloud render by 4.2 4.2 dB inside the valid circle. This advantage remains even when we evaluate alignment only on pixels where the point-cloud render is valid, indicating that the difference is not simply due to the point cloud’s missing regions.
blocks.zh: 合成器的渲染比有效圆内4.2 4.2 dB的点-云渲染更好. 即使我们只评价点-云渲染有效的像素上的等效物,但这一优势依然存在,表明差异不仅仅是由于点-云缺失的区域。

blocks.en: High coverage also does not guarantee good alignment. The untuned synthesizer covers 99.6 % 99.6\% of the valid circle and is sharper than the fine-tuned synthesizer ( 0.50 0.50 vs. 0.28 0.28 ), yet it has the worst ZNCC alignment of the three. The point-cloud render is locally sharp where geometry is available, but occlusion and depth errors reduce its coverage to 53.4 % 53.4\% , compared with 98.1 % 98.1\% for the synthesizer render.
blocks.zh: 高覆盖率也不能保证良好的一致性。 未调谐合成器覆盖有效圆圈的99.6% 99.6\%并比微调合成器更锐利(0.50 0.50对0.28 0.28),然而它却拥有了三相最差的ZNCC对接. 在有几何特征的地方,点-云渲染是局部尖锐的,但闭合和深度误差将其覆盖范围减少到53.4% 53.4% ,而合成器渲染率为98.1% 98.1% 。

blocks.en: C.2 Output Sharpness and Color
blocks.zh: C.2 输出锐度和颜色

blocks.en: Despite the difference in sharpness between the conditioning renders, their generated outputs have similar sharpness. On unseen scenes, the Laplacian-variance ratio to the ground truth is 1.10 1.10 for outputs conditioned on the point-cloud render and 1.04 1.04 for those conditioned on the synthesizer render. This indicates that output sharpness is not strongly determined by the sharpness of the conditioning render.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些条件的尖锐性不同,但它们产生的产出也具有类似的尖锐性。 在不为人知的场景中,Laplacian-vangance对地面真理的比值为:以点-云渲染为条件的输出为1.10 1.10;以合成器渲染为条件的输出为1.04.1.04. 这表明,输出的锐度不是由调制的锐度所强烈决定的.

blocks.en: Color behaves differently. On unseen scenes, the synthesizer render has a chroma ratio of only 0.41 0.41 relative to the ground truth, and the generated output shows a similar reduction, reaching 0.45 0.45 . In comparison, the output reaches 0.82 0.82 when conditioned on the point-cloud render and 1.26 1.26 without conditioning. Gating the synthesizer render partially recovers the chroma ratio to 0.62 0.62 , suggesting that removing unreliable conditioning allows the generator to rely more on its own appearance prior. Thus, unlike sharpness, output color remains more sensitive to the conditioning render.

blocks.en: The mechanism is an asymmetry between the two models. The synthesizer is a regression model, so under correspondence uncertainty it tends toward a conditional mean, in which chroma averages toward gray while luminance structure largely survives. The generator under the same uncertainty samples a plausible mode, and its color prior, acquired at pretraining scale and adapted here only through a low-rank update, is unaffected by the synthesizer’s collapse. Such conditioning over-reliance is documented for image-to-video models ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . The standard remedy, for it and for the exposure bias, is to degrade or noise-augment the conditioning during training ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) . Color drift is itself a known signature of conditioning on model-produced imagery ( Li et al., 2026 ) . FVD is particularly sensitive to such per-frame appearance statistics ( Ge et al., 2024 ) , which accounts for part of the unseen FVD gap in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 机理是两种模型之间的不对称. 合成器是一种回归模型,所以在函式不确定性下,它倾向于有条件的平均值,其中染色体平均向灰色,而发光结构则基本存活. 在同样不确定条件下的生成器样本中,有一个可行的模式,其颜色先由预训练规模获得,并仅通过低级更新在此进行改造,不受合成器倒闭的影响。 图像到视频模型记录了这种过度依赖的条件(赵等,2024年)。 对其和接触偏差而言,标准补救措施是在训练期间降解或加固空调(Ho等人,2022;Blatmann等人,2023)。 彩色漂移本身是在模型出产的相片上已知的调值标志(Li等,2026.). FVD对这种每帧外观统计特别敏感(Ge等人,2024年),占表2中看不见的FVD差距的一部分.

blocks.en: C.3 Adapting to the Fisheye Camera
blocks.zh: C.3 适应鱼眼相机

blocks.en: The untuned synthesizer does not reliably respect the target camera model, even when given the correct camera rays. On unseen scenes, it fills 95.9 % 95.9\% of the region outside the valid fisheye circle with scene content. We measure this behavior using spill , defined as the fraction of the region outside the image circle that a signal fills with content.
blocks.zh: 未调谐合成器不可靠地尊重目标相机模型,即使给定了正确的相机射线. 在未见的场景中,它将95.9%的95.9%的面积填充在有效的鱼眼圈外的场景内容. 我们用溢出来测量这一行为, 定义为一个信号充满内容的图像圆外区域的分数。

blocks.en: Simply masking this region would not solve the problem. Inside the valid field of view, the untuned synthesizer is also the worst aligned of the three conditions, trailing the fine-tuned synthesizer by 5.4 5.4 dB on unseen scenes and 10.3 10.3 dB on seen scenes. Conditioning the generator on this render further reduces performance by 0.8 0.8 dB on unseen scenes and 2.5 2.5 dB on seen scenes.
blocks.zh: 仅仅掩盖这个区域并不能解决问题。 在有效视域内,未调谐合成器也是三个条件中最差的对接器,跟随微调合成器在未见场景上为5.4分贝,在所见场景上为10.3分贝. 将发电机安装在这种装置上,进一步降低了未见场景的性能0.8分贝和所见场景的2.5分贝。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning substantially corrects both behaviors. The adapted synthesizer leaves the region outside the image circle essentially empty, with only 0.1 % 0.1\% spill, while the point-cloud render fills 22.4 % 22.4\% . Adapting the synthesizer to the target camera is therefore necessary, not optional.
blocks.zh: 精细调整实质上纠正了两种行为. 被改造的合成器使区域在图像圆外基本空出,只有0.1%.1%.1%.%.溢出,而点-云的渲染能填充22.4% 22.4%. 因此,使合成器适应目标相机是必要的,而不是可选的.

blocks.en: Table 6 reports the cost of generating one clip on a single H200 GPU, averaged over the 100 clips. Generation covers the denoising loop together with the encoding and decoding around it, and assumes that the condition is already built. End-to-end adds the cost of building the condition. During denoising, the two methods differ only in the bias they apply. GGA builds a dense attention bias over the whole canvas and reapplies it in every transformer block, which adds 252 ms to each forward pass. ARC instead updates the egocentric part of the clean estimate once per step, in 2.7 ms. The larger difference is upstream. Building our condition takes 4.7 s per clip, against 69.2 s for depth estimation and point-cloud rendering (Table 3 ). Overall, LEGO generates a clip faster than EgoX and uses slightly less memory.
blocks.zh: 表6报告制作一个H200 GPU的剪辑的费用,平均超过100个剪辑。 世代将去诺环与周围的编码和去诺环相接,并假设条件已经建成. 端到端增加建设条件的费用. 在发号施令期间,这两种方法只在所适用的偏差上有所不同. GGA在整个帆布上建立密集的注意力偏差并重新应用到每个变压器块中,每个前行通道会增加252 ms. 反之,ARC每一步更新一次干净估计中以自我为中心的部分,以2.7ms为单位. 较大的差异在于上游. 建立我们的状态每片需要4.7 s,而深度估计和点-云渲染需要69.2 s(表3)。 总体而言,LEGO生成的剪辑速度快于EgoX并使用略少的内存.

blocks.en: C.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: C.6 限制

blocks.en: LEGO inherits the limitations of the view synthesizer. F F renders each frame independently from a single exocentric frame, so it cannot recover content that the frame does not show (Fig. 8 ), and it blurs where the correspondence is uncertain. Its colors also collapse on unfamiliar scenes (Section C.2 ). The pipeline is lifting-free but still requires the camera poses of both views. Since F F is frozen and enters only through the conditioning input and the confidence map, a stronger feed-forward view synthesizer can replace it without changing the diffusion model or ARC.
blocks.zh: LEGO继承了视图合成器的局限性. F使每个帧从一个单一的外心相框中独立出,因此无法恢复帧没有显示的内容(图8),并模糊了函文不确定之处. 它的颜色在不熟悉的场景中也崩溃了(C.2节)。 管道是无起起伏的,但仍需要两种观点的相机姿势。 从F起 F被冷冻并只能通过条件输入和置信映射进入,更强大的feed-forward视图合成器可以在不改变扩散模型或ARC的情况下取而代之.

blocks.en: Figures 9 and 10 show further comparisons on the seen and unseen splits of Ego-Exo4D, and Figures 11 and 12 on EgoHumans and Nymeria. Each method runs its own checkpoint, the released one for EgoX and ours for LEGO , and both receive the same camera poses, the same text prompt, and the same random seed.

blocks.en: Across the examples, the two methods fail in the way described in Section 4 . EgoX reproduces content sharply at the wrong position, which is most visible for the hands and for objects close to the camera. LEGO keeps the scene where the ground truth places it and lets the diffusion model add the details that its condition does not carry. The same holds on EgoHumans and Nymeria. The remaining errors of LEGO are softer details and, on unseen scenes, less saturated colors (Section C.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在整个例子中,两种方法以第4节所描述的方式失效。 EgoX在错误的位置上快速地复制内容,这对手和靠近相机的物体来说最为明显. LEGO保留了地面真理所放入的场景,让扩散模型添加其条件所不携带的细节. Ego Humans和Nymeria也同样如此。 LEGO的其余出错是更软的细节,在看不见的场景中,饱和度更低(C.2节)。
